verdict.rationale: Jules offers some autonomy-related controls—plan approval before code changes, PR approval before merge, and an optional automationMode field that determines whether a PR is auto-created—which act as gating mechanisms, but there's no evidence of a formal 'tiered' system (e.g., named levels like read-only/suggest/auto-apply) or an admin/engineering-lead setting to enforce autonomy policy across a team. Missing for 10: documented named autonomy tiers, org/team-level policy controls set by a lead, and confirmation these settings apply per-user/repo rather than per-API-call.
